## Data cleaning

```{r}
df1 <- read.csv(here("data", "AHSnhs11bsp.csv"), stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
df2 <- read.csv(here("data", "AHSnhs11bbi.csv"), stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

df <- df1 %>%
  dplyr::select(ABSLID, ABSPID, SEX, SMKSTAT, ALCF3, AGEB, ALINWKSD, FEMLSBC) %>%
  filter(!(ABSLID == "NHS11B0009794" & ABSPID == 6)) %>%
  left_join(
      df2 %>%
      filter(!(ABSLID == "NHS11B0009794" & ABSPID == 6)) %>%
      dplyr::select(ABSLID, ABSPID, EGFRKDSA, DIABPRVE),
      by = c("ABSLID", "ABSPID")
    )
```

```{r}
ckd_data <- df %>%
  mutate(
    age = case_when(
      AGEB %in% 1:4 ~ NA_real_,
      AGEB == 5 ~ 18.5,
      AGEB == 6 ~ 22,
      AGEB == 7 ~ 27,
      AGEB == 8 ~ 32,
      AGEB == 9 ~ 37,
      AGEB == 10 ~ 42,
      AGEB == 11 ~ 47,
      AGEB == 12 ~ 52,
      AGEB == 13 ~ 57,
      AGEB == 14 ~ 62,
      AGEB == 15 ~ 67,
      AGEB == 16 ~ 72,
      AGEB == 17 ~ 77,
      AGEB == 18 ~ 82,
      AGEB == 19 ~ 85, 
    ),
    sex = case_when(
      SEX == 1 ~ "Male",
      SEX == 2 ~ "Female",
    ),
    ckd = case_when(
      EGFRKDSA == 1 ~ "No CKD",
      EGFRKDSA %in% 2:6 ~ "CKD",
      EGFRKDSA %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA_character_
    ),
    smoker_status = case_when(
      SMKSTAT == 5 ~ "Never smoked",
      SMKSTAT == 4 ~ "Ex-smoker",
      SMKSTAT %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "Current smoker",
      SMKSTAT == 0 ~ NA_character_
    ),
    alcohol_frequency = case_when(
      ALCF3 == 1 ~ 7,
      ALCF3 == 2 ~ 6,
      ALCF3 == 3 ~ 5,
      ALCF3 == 4 ~ 4,
      ALCF3 == 5 ~ 3,
      ALCF3 == 6 ~ 2,
      ALCF3 == 7 ~ 1,
      ALCF3 == 98 ~ NA_real_,
      ALCF3 == 97 ~ NA_real_,
      ALCF3 == 99 ~ NA_real_,
      ALCF3 %in% c(0, 8, 9, 10) ~ 0
    ), #How many days a week, that they drink three or more standards, over the last year
    alcohol_quantity = case_when(
      ALINWKSD == 97 ~ 0,
      ALINWKSD >= 0 & ALINWKSD <= 96 ~ ALINWKSD,
      ALINWKSD %in% c(98, 99) ~ NA_real_
    ),
    diabetes = case_when(
      DIABPRVE %in% c(0, 8) ~ NA_real_,
      DIABPRVE %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
      DIABPRVE %in% c(3, 4) ~ 0
    ),
    menopause = case_when(
      FEMLSBC %in% c(1:4, 6) ~ 0,
      FEMLSBC == 5 ~ 1,
      FEMLSBC == 9 ~ 2
    )
  )
```

```{r}
alcohol_type <- read.csv(here("data", "AHSnhs11b14.csv"), stringsAsFactors = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    ABSLID,
    ABSPID,
    ABSBID,
    ABSTID,
    ALCTYPT,
  )
```

```{r}
alcohol_type <- alcohol_type %>%
  mutate(
    alcohol_type = case_when(
      ALCTYPT == 1 ~ "low_alcohol_beer",
      ALCTYPT == 2 ~ "mid_strength_beer",
      ALCTYPT == 3 ~ "full_strength_beer",
      ALCTYPT == 4 ~ "white_wine",
      ALCTYPT == 5 ~ "red_wine",
      ALCTYPT == 6 ~ "low_alcohol_wine",
      ALCTYPT == 7 ~ "champagne_sparkling_wine",
      ALCTYPT == 8 ~ "spirits_rtd",
      ALCTYPT == 9 ~ "liqueurs",
      ALCTYPT == 10 ~ "spirits",
      ALCTYPT == 11 ~ "fortified_wine",
      ALCTYPT == 12 ~ "cider",
      ALCTYPT == 13 ~ "cocktails",
      ALCTYPT == 14 ~ "other",
      ALCTYPT == 0 ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Keep one record for each participant and alcohol type
alcohol_type_person <- alcohol_type %>%
  filter(!is.na(alcohol_type)) %>%
  distinct(ABSLID, ABSPID, alcohol_type) %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = alcohol_type,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```

```{r}
# Combine alcohol type and alcohol quantity at the participant level
df_final <- ckd_data %>%
  left_join(
    alcohol_type_person,
    by = c("ABSLID", "ABSPID")
  )
```

```{r}
df_filter <- df_final %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(sex),
    !is.na(ckd),
    !is.na(alcohol_quantity),
    !is.na(red_wine),
    !is.na(alcohol_frequency),
    !is.na(age),
    !is.na(smoker_status),
    !is.na(diabetes),
    age >= 35
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ckd = factor(
      ifelse(ckd == "CKD", 1, 0),
      levels = c(0, 1)
    ),
    sex = factor(
      sex,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")
    ),
    smoker_status = factor(
      smoker_status,
      levels = c(
        "Current smoker",
        "Ex-smoker",
        "Never smoked"
      )
    ),
    diabetes = factor(
      diabetes,
      levels = c(0, 1)
    ),
    menopause = factor(
      menopause,
      levels = c(0, 1, 2)
    ),
    across(
      c(
        low_alcohol_beer,
        mid_strength_beer,
        full_strength_beer,
        white_wine,
        red_wine,
        low_alcohol_wine,
        champagne_sparkling_wine,
        spirits_rtd,
        liqueurs,
        spirits,
        fortified_wine,
        cider,
        cocktails
      ),
      ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c(0, 1))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
saveRDS(df_filter, "shared_df_filter.rds")
```

### Alcohol quantity
```{r}
model_int <- glm(ckd ~ age + alcohol_quantity * sex + alcohol_frequency + diabetes + beer + wine + spirits_liqueurs + cider + cocktails, data = ckd_data, family = binomial)
```

#### Results
```{r}
model_summary <- summary(model_int)$coefficients

results_pretty <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(model_summary),

  OR = exp(model_summary[, "Estimate"]),

  `95% CI` = paste0(
    sprintf("%.2f", exp(model_summary[, "Estimate"] -
                         1.96 * model_summary[, "Std. Error"])),
    "–",
    sprintf("%.2f", exp(model_summary[, "Estimate"] +
                         1.96 * model_summary[, "Std. Error"]))
  ),

  `P-value` = ifelse(
    model_summary[, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001,
    "<0.001",
    sprintf("%.3f", model_summary[, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  ),

  check.names = FALSE
)

results_pretty$OR <- sprintf("%.2f", results_pretty$OR)

print(results_pretty, row.names = FALSE)
```

Forest plot: all variables

```{r}
plot_data <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(model_summary),
  OR = exp(model_summary[, "Estimate"]),
  Lower = exp(model_summary[, "Estimate"] -
                1.96 * model_summary[, "Std. Error"]),
  Upper = exp(model_summary[, "Estimate"] +
                1.96 * model_summary[, "Std. Error"]),
  p_value = model_summary[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
)

plot_data <- subset(plot_data, Variable != "(Intercept)")

ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(x = OR, y = reorder(Variable, OR))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper),
                 height = 0.2, color = "steelblue2") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue2") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Association between Covariates and CKD",
    x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI, log scale)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

Forest plot: compare genders

```{r}
b <- coef(model_int)
V <- vcov(model_int)

beta_female <- b["alcohol_quantity"]

se_female <- sqrt(
  V["alcohol_quantity", "alcohol_quantity"]
)

beta_male <- b["alcohol_quantity"] +
  b["alcohol_quantity:sexMale"]

se_male <- sqrt(
  V["alcohol_quantity", "alcohol_quantity"] +
  V["alcohol_quantity:sexMale",
    "alcohol_quantity:sexMale"] +
  2 * V["alcohol_quantity",
        "alcohol_quantity:sexMale"]
)

plot_interaction <- data.frame(
  Sex = c("Female", "Male"),
  OR = exp(c(beta_female, beta_male)),
  Lower = exp(c(
    beta_female - 1.96 * se_female,
    beta_male - 1.96 * se_male
  )),
  Upper = exp(c(
    beta_female + 1.96 * se_female,
    beta_male + 1.96 * se_male
  ))
)

ggplot(plot_interaction,
       aes(x = OR, y = Sex, color = Sex)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Male" = "steelblue2",
      "Female" = "tomato1"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Association between Alcohol Quantity and CKD by Sex",
    x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = "Sex",
    color = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

## GAM (alcohol only)

```{r}
# Main model: separate alcohol curves by sex, adjusted for all confounders
fit <- gam(
  ckd ~ age + sex + s(alcohol_quantity, by = sex, k = 5) +
    alcohol_frequency + diabetes + beer + wine + spirits_liqueurs +
    cider + cocktails,
  data = ckd_data, family = binomial(), method = "REML"
)

# Test sex modification: same participants and covariates in both models
separate_ml <- update(fit, method = "ML")
shared_ml <- update(
  separate_ml, . ~ . - s(alcohol_quantity, by = sex, k = 5) +
    s(alcohol_quantity, k = 5)
)
comparison <- anova(shared_ml, separate_ml, test = "Chisq")

# Manuscript results
ckd <- model.response(model.frame(fit))
c(participants = nobs(fit), CKD_cases = sum(ckd == "1"))
knitr::kable(summary(fit)$s.table[, c("edf", "p-value"), drop = FALSE],
             digits = 3, caption = "Adjusted alcohol association within each sex.")
comparison
```

```{r alcohol-curves-report, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.8, fig.cap="Change in adjusted CKD log-odds relative to 1 standard drink/day. Shading shows pointwise 95% intervals for the sex-specific estimates. Pink ticks below and blue ticks above show observed quantities for females and males, respectively."}
library(ggplot2)

d <- model.frame(fit)
ref <- 1

# Same participants and adjustment variables; only the alcohol curve changes
shared_fit <- update(
  fit, . ~ . - s(alcohol_quantity, by = sex, k = 5) +
    s(alcohol_quantity, k = 5),
  data = d
)

# Calculate the change from 1 drink/day, holding other predictors fixed
make_curve <- function(model, rows, label) {
  r <- range(rows$alcohol_quantity)
  stopifnot(ref >= r[1], ref <= r[2])
  x <- sort(unique(c(seq(r[1], r[2], length.out = 200), ref)))

  nd <- rows[rep(1, length(x)), , drop = FALSE]
  nd$alcohol_quantity <- x
  baseline <- nd
  baseline$alcohol_quantity <- ref

  D <- predict(model, nd, type = "lpmatrix") -
       predict(model, baseline, type = "lpmatrix")
  est <- drop(D %*% coef(model))
  se <- sqrt(pmax(0, rowSums((D %*% vcov(model, unconditional = TRUE)) * D)))

  data.frame(x, group = label, est, lo = est - 1.96 * se, hi = est + 1.96 * se)
}

# Each sex-specific curve stops at that group's observed limits
female <- d[tolower(as.character(d$sex)) == "female", , drop = FALSE]
male   <- d[tolower(as.character(d$sex)) == "male",   , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(female) > 0, nrow(male) > 0)

by_sex <- rbind(make_curve(fit, female, "Female"),
                make_curve(fit, male,   "Male"))
curves <- rbind(by_sex, make_curve(shared_fit, d, "Shared"))

panels <- c("Female", "Male")
cols <- c(Female = "tomato1", Male = "steelblue2")
shared <- subset(curves, group == "Shared")
observed <- list(Female = female, Male = male)

# Identical axes make the slopes visually comparable
xlim <- range(d$alcohol_quantity)
ylim <- range(0, by_sex$lo, by_sex$hi, shared$est)

op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 3), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
       heights = c(4, 1))
par(oma = c(0, 2.5, 0, 0), mgp = c(2, 0.6, 0), las = 1)

for (g in panels) {
  z <- by_sex[by_sex$group == g, ]
  col <- cols[[g]]

  par(mar = c(2, 2.7, 2, 0.7))
  plot(z$x, z$est, type = "n", xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim,
       xlab = "", ylab = "", main = g, col.main = col, bty = "l")

  polygon(c(z$x, rev(z$x)), c(z$lo, rev(z$hi)),
          col = adjustcolor(col, alpha.f = 0.18), border = NA)
  abline(h = 0, col = "#B56A00", lty = 3)
  abline(v = ref, col = "grey70", lty = 3)
  lines(shared$x, shared$est, col = "grey35", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
  lines(z$x, z$est, col = col, lwd = 2.5)

  rug(observed[[g]]$alcohol_quantity,
      side = 1,
      col = adjustcolor(col, alpha.f = 0.35), ticksize = 0.035)
}

mtext("Change in CKD log-odds (vs 1 drink/day)",
      side = 2, outer = TRUE, line = 0.7, las = 0)

# One x-axis label and one legend for both panels
par(mar = rep(0, 4))
plot.new()
text(0.5, 0.91, "Average daily standard drinks in the previous week")

legend("center", ncol = 4, bty = "n", cex = 0.78,
       legend = c("Female estimate", "Male estimate",
                  "Shared estimate", "Zero change",
                  "95% interval", "1 drink/day",
                  "Female observations", "Male observations"),
       col = c(cols, "grey35", "#B56A00", "grey75", "grey70", cols),
       lty = c(1, 1, 2, 3, NA, 3, NA, NA),
       lwd = c(2.5, 2.5, 2, 1, NA, 1, NA, NA),
       pch = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, 15, NA, "|", "|"))

layout(1)
par(op)
```

### Smoking
```{r}
# no smoking, model 1, reduced
model_smoking_reduced <- glm(ckd ~ age + sex + diabetes, data = ckd_data, family = binomial)

# smoking + sex, model 2, additive
model_smoking_additive <- glm(ckd ~ age + smoker_status + sex + diabetes, data = ckd_data, family = binomial)

# model 3, interaction
model_smoking_interaction <- glm(ckd ~ age + smoker_status * sex + diabetes, data = ckd_data, family = binomial)
```

LRT between model 1 and model 2: Smoking overall association
```{r}
anova(model_smoking_reduced, model_smoking_additive, test = "LRT")
```

LRT between model 2 and model 3: Whether sex modifies the association
```{r}
anova(model_smoking_additive, model_smoking_interaction, test = "LRT")
```

## Method Descriptive Summaries 

```{r}

age_labels <- c("35-39", "40-44", "45-49", "50-54", "55-59", "60-64",
                "65-69", "70-74", "75-79", "80-84", "85+")

plot_data <- df_filter %>%
  mutate(
    AgeGroup = cut(age,
                   breaks = c(34, 39, 44, 49, 54, 59, 64, 69, 74, 79, 84, Inf),
                   labels = age_labels, right = TRUE),
    Sex = factor(sex)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AgeGroup)) %>%
  count(Sex, AgeGroup) %>%
  mutate(
    Proportion     = n / sum(n),                        
    PlotProportion = ifelse(Sex == "Male", -Proportion, Proportion)
  )

lim <- ceiling(max(plot_data$Proportion) * 100) / 100   # symmetric axis from the data

p_pyramid <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = AgeGroup, y = PlotProportion, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x) * 100, "%"),
    limits = c(-lim, lim)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = "steelblue2", "Female" = "tomato1")) +
  labs(
    title = "Age and sex structure of the study population",
    x = "Age group (years)",
    y = "% of all respondents",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_pyramid
ggsave(here("figures", "age_sex_pyramid.png"), plot = p_pyramid,
       width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```
